figures.title: Architecture
figures.caption: c1 net 310: layer sizes read from the saved weights. One trunk, two heads: 34 logits (a card, or pass) for whatever decision is asked, and a win estimate.

figures.title: Weights per layer
figures.caption: A wide, centred histogram means the layer is used; a spike at 0 means dead units.

figures.title: How often it does what the GA genome would do
figures.caption: On positions from games against the GA base: the share of decisions, per kind, where the network's top choice equals the genome's. rl-v1 began by imitating the genome; low agreement shows where training has moved it away.

figures.title: What it buys as training goes on
figures.caption: For snapshots along the run: what the network buys (top choice) in 40 games against itself, as a share of all its buys.

figures.title: What it looks at
figures.caption: How much its choices move (total variation, averaged over all recorded decisions) when one input is nudged by one standard deviation. The 25 most influential of the 413 inputs.
